system.description: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.omvngnmoo75is54f]{Spare the Dying} cantrip. At 3rd level you may cast the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.it4gev1vr8gmecok]{False Life} once per long rest. At 5th level, you may cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.724qyfqw7qcpe1ol]{Gentle Repose} once per long rest. These spells do not count against the number of spells you know and do not require material components. Your spellcasting modifier for these spells is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.
